patch.value: Compile bounded Slack payloads with exact loss receipts
Compile Slack wire payloads with per-field clipping and omission receipts plus stable recovery links. Scope excludes generic redaction, output budgeting and renderer registries.

Oversized block and text fixtures respect documented payload bounds; Every clipped source span is accounted for with a recovery link; Urgent status and identity fields are never silently removed; Malformed payloads refuse before sending

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap recheck: core output budgets govern JSON/TOON projection, existing attention coalescing governs event counts, and pm-slack-standup owns standup generation. Existing Slack renderers truncate fields without receipts. No equivalent compiler or duplicate open item/PR found. Design: a pure bounded compiler and strict shared wire schema; explicit protected paths and stable recovery URLs; SDK-backed read-only item projection; no new durable state, leases, import, sync, or remote writes. Existing delivery state machines remain separate. No transaction isolation claim: commitWorkspaceTransaction does not exclude ordinary writers (pm-cli#1620). Read-only compilation observes a snapshot and never applies a saved plan.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implementation: shared strict static Block Kit schema validates compiler inputs and every outbound webhook payload; pure compiler records nonoverlapping original UTF-16 ranges, typed protected_overflow refusals and recovery links. SDK item projection protects identity, status, priority, assignee, parent and full dependency fields without lifecycle name comparisons. Canonical full SDK reads explicitly disable output budgets; command uses only the host-injected client. Compact paginated TOON/JSON output carries a source digest. Focused oversized/schema/zero-socket tests pass; seeded 500-sequence no-git readback and packed acceptance are underway.
